$description: Unified cross-reference index — one hub per component joining tokens, god-nodes touched, WCAG SCs, guideline docs, anti-patterns (asserted vs inferred), relationships and deprecated bindings. Enables multi-hop queries (component->tokens->other components; component->SC->sibling components; component->guideline). Derived view over the authored canon + the two generated indexes; regenerate via _build_xref_index.py. god_nodes_touched = tokens with blast>=7.
guideline_map_note: guidelines = GLOBAL (apply to all) + TOPICAL (curated per component). Authored, not inferred.
